no_modeled_ligand_apo.evidence_required: RCSB entry and primary paper structure description

no_inhibitor_ligand_only_cofactor.label_zh: 无抑制剂配体：仅辅因子
no_inhibitor_ligand_only_cofactor.evidence_required: RCSB non-polymer entities plus paper methods

modeled_ligand_is_additive.label_zh: 配体为结晶添加物或溶剂，不属于抑制剂
modeled_ligand_is_additive.label_en: Modeled ligand is a crystallization additive or solvent
modeled_ligand_is_additive.evidence_required: Chemical component identity and paper context

no_quantitative_value.label_zh: 无数值：原文未报告定量活性
no_quantitative_value.evidence_required: Full text and relevant tables/figures inspected

single_concentration_only.label_zh: 无数值：仅有单浓度抑制
single_concentration_only.label_en: Single concentration or percent inhibition only
single_concentration_only.evidence_required: Exact concentration, readout and source locator

qualitative_inhibition_only.label_zh: 无数值：仅有定性抑制证据
qualitative_inhibition_only.evidence_required: Figure or gel panel plus exact condition and locator

censored_value_only.label_zh: 无数值：原文仅报告删失阈值
censored_value_only.evidence_required: Exact qualifier, threshold, unit and source locator

non_affinity_measurement_only.label_zh: 无数值：仅有非亲和力测量（如Tm）
non_affinity_measurement_only.evidence_required: Measurement type, value and source locator

cell_phenotype_only.label_zh: 无数值：仅有细胞表型数据，非靶点亲和力
cell_phenotype_only.label_en: Cell phenotype only, not target affinity
cell_phenotype_only.evidence_required: Cell line, virus, endpoint and source locator

metal_or_rna_binding_only.label_zh: 无数值：仅有金属或RNA结合数据

model_estimate_only.label_zh: 无数值：仅有模型外推值

ambiguous_compound_identity.label_zh: 无数值：化合物身份无法精确对应
ambiguous_compound_identity.evidence_required: HET, InChIKey, paper table and construct evidence

mutation_or_construct_mismatch.label_zh: 无数值：突变或构体与PDB状态不匹配
mutation_or_construct_mismatch.evidence_required: Paper mutation plus deposited construct comparison

access_blocked.label_zh: 无数值：原文或补充材料无法访问
access_blocked.evidence_required: Blocker ledger with access fallback attempts

database_only_lead.label_zh: 无数值：仅有数据库线索
database_only_lead.evidence_required: Exact query, export scope and SHA-256
